title: Head of AWS Communications, India, AWS Comms India
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon Web Services (AWS) is looking for a self\-motivated, high\-judgment, well\-connected, and experienced senior communications leader to join its APJC team, leading communications in India.  

  

The right candidate possesses extensive media relations experience, is an expert communicator adept at synthesizing and translating complex concepts, including technology, into broadly digestible information. This leader will be an experienced people manager, has successfully delivered executive communications programs, and can exercise high\-judgment decisions while acting quickly and collaboratively.  

  

The candidate must have proven experience managing communications functions in India, including managing agencies and budgets. They will partner across the AWS business and Amazon to develop external communications strategies and best practices, as well as manage issues, provide strategic counsel, and execute a variety of strategic communications campaigns.  

  

This role reports directly to the Head of Communications, APJC and is a key member of the AWS Communications APJC leadership team. You will partner closely with Communications peers locally, regionally, and globally to drive a cohesive and ambitious communications agenda across the region.  

  

The ideal candidate enjoys diving deep into and using technology, as well as communicating how technology is shaping and redefining the world we live in. They are motivated by a dynamic, innovative, and creative culture.  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

* Manage and coach a team in India, setting clear goals, fostering growth, and maintaining high standards of execution
* Define, develop, and oversee end\-to\-end execution of communications strategy and programs for India, from annual planning and goal\-setting through to delivery, measurement, and scaling
* Ensure a consistent, high\-impact, and factually accurate representation of AWS in Indian media, underpinned by strong relationships with top\-tier Indian media, key opinion leaders, technology influencers, and industry analysts
* Plan and lead proactive media relations programs and campaigns that generate meaningful coverage and position AWS as a trusted technology leader in India
* Develop and execute high\-impact technology and innovation campaigns that showcase AWS customers and partners stories
* Lead communications strategy and execution for large\-scale events—encompassing media relations, executive positioning, customer storytelling, content production, and on\-site execution
* Regularly interact with India senior leadership to influence strategy and negotiate decisions in relation to issues, announcements, and messaging
* Provide executive communications support to the President, AWS India and South Asia, as well as other senior India\-based business leaders and visiting executives, on media engagements, reputation, messaging, and communications opportunities
* Engage cross\-functionally to plan and execute communications plans with marketing, public policy, analyst relations, and business development teams
**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 15\+ years of professional communications, public relations, or public affairs experience
* Demonstrated expertise in media relations, with an established network of media contacts across India
* Experience in enterprise or business\-to\-business technology communications
* Experience in policy communications, issues management, and crisis communications
* Experience planning and delivering large\-scale integrated communications programs for major events
* Experience in operational and strategic planning, including annual planning cycles, goal\-setting, budget ownership, and performance reporting
* People management experience, including leading and developing communications teams
* Excellent written and oral communication skills in English
* Outstanding attention to detail, understanding of technology, and ability to communicate complex topics effectively

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience developing integrated communications campaigns around cloud computing, AI or emerging digital technologies
* Experience representing high\-profile companies in fast\-paced, complex, high\-stakes environments
* Experience working across borders in regional or global teams
* An entrepreneurial spirit, including ability to work independently and autonomously

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

title: Data Modeler
description:
**Job Description: Essential Duties:*** Understand and translate business needs into data models supporting long\-term solutions.
* Work with the Application Development team to implement data strategies, build data flows and develop conceptual data models.
* Create and maintain conceptual, logical and physical data models using best practices to ensure high data quality and reduced redundancy, along with corresponding metadata.
* Optimize and update logical and physical data models to support new and existing projects.
* Develop best practices for standard naming conventions and coding practices to ensure consistency of data models.
* Recommend opportunities for reuse of data models in new environments.
* Perform reverse engineering of physical data models from databases and SQL scripts.
* Evaluate data models and physical databases for variances and discrepancies.
* Validate business data objects for accuracy and completeness.
* Analyse data\-related system integration challenges and propose appropriate solutions.
* Develop data models according to company standards. Guide System Analysts, Engineers, Programmers and others on project limitations and capabilities, performance requirements and interfaces.
* Review modifications to existing software to improve efficiency and performance.
* Examine new application design and recommend corrections if required.
* Assist with and support setting the data architecture direction (including data movement approach, architecture / technology strategy, and any other data\-related considerations to ensure business value,) ensuring data architecture deliverables are developed, ensuring compliance to standards and guidelines, implementing the data architecture, and supporting technical developers at a project or business unit level.
* Coordinate and consult with the project manager, client business staff, client technical staff and project developers in data architecture best practices and anything else that is data related at the project or business unit levels

  
**Responsibilities: Required Qualifications:**

* 7\-10 Years industry implementation experience with one or more data modelling tools such as Erwin, ERStudio, PowerDesigner etc.
* Minimum of 8 years of data architecture, data modelling (Data Vault and Dimensional, 3NF) or similar experience
* 5\-7 years of management experience required
* 5\-7 years consulting experience preferred
* Experience working with dimensionally modelled data
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience, Master’s Degree Preferred
* Understanding of cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP, Snowflake preferred) and on premises architectures
* Experience in data analysis and profiling
* Strong data warehousing and OLTP systems from an integration perspective
* Strong understanding of data integration best practices and concepts
* Strong SQL skills required scripting preferred
* Strong Knowledge of all phases of the system development life cycle
* Experience with major database and big data platforms (e.g. RDS, Aurora, Redshift, Databricks, MySQL, Oracle, PostgresSQL, Hadoop, Snowflake, etc.)
* Understanding and experience with major Data Architecture philosophies (Dimensional, ODS, Data Vault, etc.)
* Understanding of modern data warehouse capabilities and technologies such as real\-time, cloud, Big Data

  
**Qualifications: Preferred Skills \& Experience:**

* Involved in documenting user requirements, business process and translation of business process into technical documents.
* Created Data Architect designs/documents for business processing requirements.
* Analyzed and audited Requirements \& Business Processes.
* Prepared Business Matrix diagram to identify business processes, dimensions, facts, conformed dimensions, junk and degenerate dimensions.
* Worked as a part of the review and collaboration sessions regarding business processes, canonical (BOM) modeling.
* Profile the source system data to identify the business process and business requirement with operational system data.
* Designed/captured the business processes \& then mapped them to the conceptual data model.
* Involved in modeling business processes through UML diagrams using Rational Rose.
* Prepared Test Scenarios based on understanding of business process flow.
* Assisted in process model development, identifying business process needs and requirements and modeling into useable, business\-driven data processes.
* Participate in requirement gathering, design review and code review meetings Analyse business process and optimize existing extract stored procedures.
* Redefined many attributes and relationships in the reverse engineered model and cleansed unwanted table/columns as part of data analysis responsibility.
* Reviewed Entities and relationships in the engineered model and cleansed unwanted tables/ columns as part of data analysis responsibilities.
* Conducted logical data analysis and data modeling joint application design (JAD) sessions, documented data\-related standards.
* Performed data analysis to support mapping and transformation of data from legacy systems to physical data models.
* Gather accurate data by data analysis and functional analysis.
* Conduct logical data modeling and data analysis.
* Involved in developing SQL queries for extracting data from test and production databases to perform data analysis and data quality checks.
* Worked with tools like TOAD for data analysis, SQL assistant, Tortoise SVN and red gate's SQL compare.
* Developed robust and efficient oracle PL/SQL procedures, packages and functions that were useful for day to day data analysis.
* Conducted data analysis on application views, functions and triggers, and tuned for performance, fixed missing/wrongly mapped data.
* Involved in the data mapping, data analysis and Gap analysis between the Legacy systems and the Vendor Packages.
* Performed Data Profiling and Data Analysis using SQL queries looking for Data issues, Data anomalies.
* Defined Data architecture Strategy, Data Management Strategy, data standards, Data architectural.
* Consolidated and generated database standards and naming conventions to enhance Enterprise Data Architecture processes.
* Developed an activity centered data architecture and a process architecture for automated data extraction.
* Analyzed, documented and articulated the customer's current data warehouse/data mart architecture.
* Generated Logical Data Models for old databases using Reverse engineering and documented in order to implement Forward Engineering procedures.
* Designed and implemented procedures for mapping interface data between legacy systems and a new implementation.
* Revised and rewrote their design specifications, established internal procedures for product certification.
* Designed standards and procedures to manage metadata in a structured and unstructured data environments.
* Mentored existing staff on data administrative processes procedures and standards.
* Created standards and procedures for metadata collection and repository maintenance.
* Designed and developed several complex database procedures, packages.
* Developed business specific custom reports using PL/SQL procedures.
* Established auditing procedures to ensure data integrity.
* Developed stored procedures to implement business logic.
* Design Functional Testing Standard Operating Procedures.
* Worked with different team to provide them with the essential stored procedures and packages and the required access to the data.
* Developed and optimized database structures, stored procedures, dynamic management views, DDL triggers, cursors and user defined functions

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Senior Manager
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The ideal candidate will serve as the technical lead for BCG's SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud ERP platform, driving architectural decisions and delivering solutions for complex business requirements across the firm's Finance function. Working within an Agile squad environment, this role goes beyond hands\-on delivery — the candidate will be responsible for defining the technical direction, establishing best practices, and ensuring the overall quality and scalability of the ABAP Cloud extensibility landscape. As a technical leader, you will partner closely with functional, finance to translate complex requirements into robust, future\-proof architectures. You will also serve as a coach and mentor to junior and mid\-level ABAP engineers, elevating the capability of the broader team

  

What You'll Bring

* 10\+ years of ABAP development experience, with at least 2–3 years in S/4HANA Cloud (Public or Private Edition).
* Demonstrated experience in a technical architect or lead role, owning solution design for complex ERP extensibility programmes.

**Deep expertise in:**

* + CDS View modeling and virtual data model (VDM) design
	+ RAP BO lifecycle including managed and unmanaged scenarios
	+ WRICEF object development at scale
	+ Key User and Developer Extensibility frameworks
	+ SAP API and Communication Scenario configuration
	+ BADI Framework implementation with upgrade\-safe techniques
	+ Adobe Forms in S/4HANA Cloud
	+ Object\-Oriented ABAP and Design Patterns
	+ Job creation and monitoring in cloud environments
* Strong grasp of SAP Clean Core strategy and its practical implications for extensibility decisions.
* Proven ability to set technical direction, govern standards, and influence without formal authority.
* Experience coaching and mentoring engineers across different levels of seniority.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to engage both technical teams and non\-technical business stakeholders.

  

Who You'll Work With


A dynamic group of cross\-functional global agile team\-members representing Finance, IT, and Change Management at all levels of their career. You will also support BCG users across the organization as well as BCG suppliers and business partners.

  

Additional info

**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

 **Architecture \& Solution Design**

  

* Architecting end\-to\-end extensibility solutions for SAP S/4HANA Public Cloud, balancing business complexity with SAP's Clean Core principles.
* Leading solution design for complex WRICEF objects, RAP Business Objects, and API\-based integrations, ensuring scalability, reusability, and upgrade compliance.
* Evaluating trade\-offs between Key User Extensibility, Developer Extensibility, and side\-by\-side extension approaches, and recommending the right fit for each scenario.
* Defining and governing the overall technical blueprint for ABAP Cloud extensions across the ERP landscape.

**Technical Leadership \& Standards**

  

* Establishing and enforcing ABAP development best practices, coding standards, and design patterns across the team.
* Leading and governing peer code reviews, ensuring adherence to Clean Core, OOP ABAP principles, and maintainability standards.
* Driving performance tuning and optimization strategies at an architectural level, not just at the object level.
* Staying current with SAP roadmap, release notes, and emerging extensibility capabilities, and proactively advising the team on adoption.

**Delivery \& Hands\-on Contribution**

  

* Designing and implementing advanced CDS Views, RAP BOs, BADIs, OData/REST APIs, and Communication Arrangements for complex business scenarios.
* Overseeing Transport Request strategy including Software Collections, TR sequencing, and dependency management across landscapes.
* Performing deep\-dive issue analysis, root cause analysis (RCA), and impact assessments for critical production and test environment issues.
* Configuring and managing Job Scheduling and Application Jobs in the S/4HANA Cloud environment.

**Coaching \& Mentoring**

  

* Acting as a technical mentor and go\-to resource for junior and mid\-level ABAP engineers on the team.
* Conducting knowledge\-sharing sessions, technical workshops, and design walkthroughs to upskill the broader engineering team.
* Supporting engineers in debugging complex issues in Eclipse ADT and guiding them toward sustainable, best\-practice solutions.
* Providing constructive feedback during code reviews with a focus on growth and capability building.

  

Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: RIS AI&Data DMS (Data Managed Services) SA - L7
description:
**Job Description Overview:**  

Accenture's Data \& AI practice empowers global enterprises to modernize data foundations, scale generative and agentic AI, and achieve measurable business reinvention. Its end\-to\-end capabilities span data platform modernization, cloud migration of legacy data estates, development of cutting\-edge AI and Gen AI solutions, and production support of AI \& Data applications.
  
  

**You Are:** \[DMS \- Data Managed Services SA]
  
  

As a Data Managed Services Presales Solution Architect, you will lead the end\-to\-end solution blueprint and roadmap, acting as the bridge between client vision and technology execution. You will be instrumental in translating business problems into technology solutions and having stakeholder alignment throughout the deal lifecycle. In this role, you’ll gain experience in designing Data \& AI application maintenance and support solutions, working across global delivery and sales teams. You will work cross clouds, cross industry cross geography giving depth and breadth of exposure. You’ll also deepen your expertise in emerging technologies like Databricks, Snowflake, Gen AI, Agents —preparing you for the future.
  
  

**The Work:**  

Understand RFP/RFIs and translate the business needs into technical architecture (data engineering, data visualization, AI, Gen AI).
  
  

Understand end\-to\-end application architectures diagrams (data ingestion to data consumption to AI/ML).
  
  

Map technology components (e.g. Informatica, Power BI, PySpark, Azure ML, Azure Foundry, GCP BigQuery, AWS Glue, Snowflake, Databricks etc.) with business use cases.
  
  

Prepare detailed ADM effort estimates for application maintenance and enhancements and get them validated with AI \& Data capability SMEs.
  
  

Design optimal staffing models based on onshore/offshore/nearshore mix and pyramid structure.
  
  

Build solution plan power point decks for use in sales and delivery alignment.
  
  

Engage in solution and delivery reviews with leadership across geographies.
  
  

Act as the strategic link between sales and delivery teams.
  
  

Contribute to client\-facing proposals, SOWs, and contracting documents.
  
  

Present and defend your solution in internal and external forums.
  
  

Seamlessly transition the solution to the delivery team post\-deal closure.
  
  

Travel may be required for this role. The amount of travel will vary from 10% to 25% depending on business need and client requirements.
  
  

**Here’s What You Need:**  

**Must Have:** Strong Data engineering or Business intelligence or AI/Gen AI experience in application maintenance projects
  
  

Working knowledge of cloud ecosystems – Azure or AWS, or Google Cloud.
  
  

Basic proficiency in Microsoft Excel (Pivot tables, filters, vlookup etc.).
  
  

Exceptional stakeholder management and communication skills.
  
  

Experience working in cross\-functional and global environments.
  
  

**Experience:** Minimum 12 years of relevant IT industry experience in AI \& Data delivery or Presales
  
  

**Location:** Any city having Accenture office.
  
  

**Education:** 15 years of full\-time education required.
  
  

**Bonus Points If you have:**  

Good PowerPoint skills for leadership and client storytelling.
  
  

External client\-facing experience

title: Large Language Model Architect
description:
**Project Role :** Large Language Model Architect  

**Project Role Description :** Architect large language models (LLM) that can process and generate natural language. Design neural network parameters, trained on large quantities of unlabeled text data.
  

**Must have skills :** Large Language Models (LLMs)  

**Good to have skills :** Microsoft Azure Data Services  

Minimum **5** year(s) of experience is required  

**Educational Qualification :** 15 years full time education  

  

Summary:
  

AI Powered Tech Talent  

Role Summary / Description  

Engineer role in AI LLM Technology Architecture for Level 8/9\. Hands\-on engineering role focused on designing, building, integrating, testing and operationalizing enterprise\-grade LLM, GenAI and agentic AI components across active client engagements.  

Own platform\-specific engineering on Azure, translating high\-level architecture into working, production\-quality components for LLM\-driven applications, RAG pipelines, multi\-agent workflows and AI platform integrations.  

Bring practical industry experience in banking, insurance, healthcare, public sector, retail or energy to identify domain data, process constraints, controls and adoption risks while designing GenAI solutions that are safe, scalable and relevant.  

Operate as a hands\-on Level 9 technical lead or Level 8 engineering lead, contributing code, design decisions, reusable patterns and engineering documentation.  

  

Key Responsibilities  

Design and build LLM application components including prompts, tools, agents, orchestration flows, memory/context handling, retrieval pipelines and evaluation harnesses.  

Create Foundry\-based agents with enterprise tools, knowledge and memory integrate Azure AI Search for RAG implement secure API/tool calls through API Management, Logic Apps and Functions instrument traces, evaluations, guardrails and policy controls for production agents.  

Implement data ingestion, parsing, chunking, enrichment, embeddings, vector search and retrieval workflows for structured and unstructured enterprise content.  

Engineer safety and control components including PII detection/redaction, prompt\-injection defenses, content filters, guardrails, authentication, authorization, lineage and audit logging.  

Collaborate with architects, data engineers, product owners and security stakeholders to convert solution designs into tested, observable and maintainable software components.  

Maintain technical artifacts such as component designs, integration specifications, deployment runbooks, evaluation results and reusable engineering patterns.  

  

Required Qualifications  

Bachelor s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, Information Technology or a related engineering discipline.  

Level 9: typically 5\+ years of software/data/AI engineering experience, including 2\+ years in cloud\-native engineering and 1\+ year in GenAI, LLM, NLP or agentic AI delivery.  

Level 8: typically 7\+ years of software/data/AI engineering experience, including 3\+ years in cloud\-native architecture/engineering and 1–2\+ years in GenAI, LLM, NLP or agentic AI delivery.  

Hands\-on coding experience in Python and strong understanding of APIs, distributed systems, CI/CD, testing, observability and secure SDLC practices.  

Experience delivering AI/ML or data products in at least one industry domain such as banking, insurance, healthcare, public sector, retail or energy.  

  

Required Skills/ Experience  

Hands\-on experience with Microsoft Foundry / Azure AI Foundry, Foundry Agent Service, Azure OpenAI models, Azure AI Search, Prompt Flow, Azure Functions, Logic Apps, API Management, Event Grid, Microsoft Fabric, Entra ID, Key Vault, Azure Monitor and Application Insights.  

Strong understanding of LLM application architecture patterns including RAG, function/tool calling, agent orchestration, model invocation, prompt engineering, embeddings, vector databases and evaluation metrics.  

Ability to implement traditional ML and GenAI components across ingestion, feature/data preparation, model integration, deployment, monitoring and continuous improvement.  

Practical knowledge of security, privacy, governance, performance, scalability, reliability and cost controls for production AI systems.  

Experience with Git\-based development, automated testing, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure\-as\-code and agile delivery in client\-facing environments.  

  

Good to Have Skills  

Azure AI Engineer, Azure Solutions Architect or Azure Developer certification experience with Microsoft Fabric, Semantic Kernel, Prompt Flow, private networking, Defender for Cloud and enterprise Responsible AI governance.  

Exposure to open\-source frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, Haystack, MLflow, FastAPI, Docker and Kubernetes.  

Experience with Responsible AI, model risk management, synthetic data generation, human\-in\-the\-loop review, A/B testing and GenAI cost optimization.


  

15 years full time education

title: Japanese Language Expert (Lead Service Management)
description:

We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI\-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well\-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

Track record of delivering IT Service Management (ITIL) infrastructure projects within a technically complex and dynamic environment, specifically that required to support multiple business.

* Experience in working with Japanese clients or in a multicultural team is preferred.

Keen on personal and professional development.  
*

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

And through it all, you’ll be part of a culture that values empathy, restless learning, and a devotion to shared success.
  

  

We want you to thrive here—and we’re committed to helping you do just that. Ready to make an impact? Join us and help shape what’s next.


**Get Referred!**

title: Global IT Platform Engineer Manager - Azure & Power Platform
description:
Who We Are


Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963\. Today, we help clients with total transformation\-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom\-line impact.  

  

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading\-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

  

What You'll Do


The **IT Platform Engineer Specialist \- Azure \& Power Platform** supports the engineering, evolution, and day\-to\-day operations of the Digital Marketing platform, hosted in the Azure Cloud. You will take reliable ownership of core Azure infrastructure and operations tasks — provisioning services, setting up monitoring, managing credential lifecycle, and applying tagging and cost\-code discipline — as well as CI/CD pipelines for Power Platform solutions, while building a basic working understanding of Azure Function Apps and Azure API Management (APIM).


This is an ideal role for someone early in their cloud and platform engineering career who is curious about how modern Azure platforms are run day to day, is eager to invest in continuous learning through a Center of Excellence, and wants a clear path toward architectural design exposure, multi\-platform ownership, and deeper Azure API and software development capabilities.

 **Azure Cloud Infrastructure \& Operations**

* Provision and configure core Azure services — including subscriptions, service bus, key vault, and function apps — to support the Digital Marketing team’s applications.
* Set up monitoring and insights across both Azure infrastructure and Power Platform flows, giving teams clear visibility into system health.
* Proactively manage the credential lifecycle — documenting and tracking expirations to prevent outages or security gaps.
* Apply tagging and cost\-code reporting to support budget accountability across the Azure environment.

**CI/CD \& Deployment**

* Own deployment pipelines for Power Platform solutions using GitHub Actions, enhancing low\-code / no\-code delivery.
* Build a basic working understanding of creating Azure Function Apps and configuring Azure API Management (APIM), supporting senior engineers on delivery tasks.

**Working Style \& Team Contribution**

* Take reliable ownership of assigned tasks and see them through completion.
* Actively engage in team ceremonies, with genuine curiosity about sprint work beyond assigned tickets.
* Contribute to knowledge\-sharing and continuous improvement activities across the team.
* Show a strong willingness to learn new cloud and platform engineering capabilities.
* Invest in public speaking and mentoring outside of work.

**Areas of Learning \& Growth**

* Build exposure to architectural design and reusable platform patterns.
* Progress toward owning multi\-platform engagements end\-to\-end.
* Deepen Azure API configurations and software development capabilities.

  

What You'll Bring

* 3 or more years of hands\-on experience with Azure Cloud
* Working familiarity with core Azure services — subscriptions, service bus, key vault, function apps — or the ability to ramp up quickly
* Exposure to CI/CD pipelines, ideally with GitHub Actions (Azure DevOps also acceptable)
* Familiarity with the Power Platform (Power Apps, Power Automate) or a strong willingness to learn low\-code / no\-code delivery
* Basic understanding of monitoring, logging, and observability concepts (Azure Monitor, Application Insights, or similar)
* Comfort with credential and secret management practices in a cloud environment
* Familiarity with version control using Git / GitHub
* Nice to have:
* Exposure to creating Azure Function Apps and configuring Azure API Management (APIM)
* Microsoft certifications such as AZ\-900 (Azure Fundamentals) or PL\-900 (Power Platform Fundamentals)
* Experience contributing to a Center of Excellence, tech community, or internal knowledge\-sharing initiative
* Awareness of AI capabilities for Azure.

  

Who You'll Work With


You will work within the Digital Marketing platform engineering team across multiple geographies, learning under the guidance of senior platform engineers and collaborating with architects, security, and application teams. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to internal tools used globally across BCG while building the foundations of a broader platform engineering career.

  

Additional info

Strong task ownership, attention to detail, and a demonstrable habit of continuous learning

title: Senior Engineer - RPA
description:
### **Role Summary**


We are looking for a highly skilled **Senior RPA \& AI Developer** to design, develop, and support intelligent automation solutions using RPA, Generative AI, and related technologies. The role requires strong hands\-on development expertise, solution design capabilities, and the ability to work closely with business stakeholders to deliver scalable automation solutions.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Design, develop, test, and deploy RPA and AI\-enabled automation solutions.
* Build automations using UiPath, Power Automate, or similar platforms.
* Integrate AI/GenAI capabilities such as LLMs, OCR, NLP, and IDP into automation workflows.
* Analyze business processes and identify automation opportunities.
* Develop reusable components, frameworks, and best practices.
* Perform code reviews and ensure adherence to development standards.
* Integrate bots with enterprise applications, APIs, databases, and cloud services.
* Support production deployments, incident resolution, and enhancement activities.
* Collaborate with business analysts, architects, and support teams during project delivery.
* Create and maintain technical documentation, design specifications, and operational runbooks.

### **Required Skills**

### **RPA \& Automation**

* 4\+ years of hands\-on experience in **UiPath** and/or **Microsoft Power Automate**.
* Experience developing attended and unattended automation solutions.
* Strong understanding of Orchestrator, queues, assets, exception handling, and framework\-based development.

### **AI \& Emerging Technologies**

* Experience with **Generative AI**, **Azure OpenAI**, **Copilot Studio**, or similar AI platforms.
* Understanding of AI Agents, Agentic AI, prompt engineering, and retrieval\-based solutions.
* Experience with OCR, NLP, Intelligent Document Processing (IDP), and document understanding.

### **Technical Skills**

* Proficiency in **Python**, **C\#/.NET**, SQL, and REST APIs.
* Experience integrating with SAP, ServiceNow, Salesforce, Oracle, or web applications.
* Good understanding of Azure services and cloud\-based automation architectures.
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile development methodologies.

### **Preferred Qualifications**

* UiPath Advanced RPA Developer Certification.
* Microsoft Power Platform or Azure AI Certifications.
* Experience working on enterprise\-scale automation programs.
* Exposure to Process Mining, Task Mining, and Analytics platforms.

### **Key Competencies**

* Strong problem\-solving and analytical skills.
* Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
* Excellent stakeholder communication and collaboration skills.
* Ownership mindset with focus on quality and delivery.
* Mentoring junior developers and supporting knowledge\-sharing initiatives

**Salary Range:**


The salary range reflected above is a good faith estimate of base pay for the primary location of the position. The salary for this position ultimately will be determined based on the education, experience, knowledge, and abilities of the successful candidate. In addition to salary, this role may also be eligible for annual, sales, or other incentive compensation.

Through skill\-building, leadership development and philanthropic opportunities, we provide opportunities to build communities and grow your career, surrounded by diverse colleagues with high ethical standards.

As part of Guardian’s Purpose – to inspire well\-being – we are committed to offering contemporary, supportive, flexible, and inclusive benefits and resources to our colleagues. Explore our company benefits at www.guardianlife.com/careers/corporate/benefits. *Benefits apply to full\-time eligible employees. Interns are not eligible for most Company benefits.*

All qualified applicants will be considered for employment without regard to age, race, color, creed, religion, sex, affectional or sexual orientation, national origin, ancestry, marital status, disability, military or veteran status, or any other classification protected by applicable law.

 **Accommodations**

  

Guardian is committed to providing access, equal opportunity and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. Guardian also provides reasonable accommodations to qualified job applicants (and employees) to accommodate the individual's known limitations related to pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions, unless doing so would create an undue hardship. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please contact MyHR@glic.com. Please note: this resource is for accommodation requests only. For all other inquires related to your application and careers at Guardian, refer to the Guardian Careers site.

 **Visa Sponsorship**

  

Guardian Life is not currently or in the foreseeable future sponsoring employment\-based visas (e.g., such as an H\-1B). In order to be a successful applicant, you must be legally authorized to work in the United States, without the need for employer sponsorship/support now or at any time in the future.

This preliminary screening may be used to help identify applicant materials and resumes relative to their indication that the applicant meets the requirements for the specific job for which they are applying, as specified in the listing posted on Guardian’s jobs website (Careers at Guardian at https://www.guardianlife.com/careers). All hiring decisions will be made by Guardian colleagues.

  

Please be aware that if you apply for a specific position with Guardian, you will have the choice of opting out of Guardian’s use of AI Tools during the job application process. If you would like to request an alternative process that does not utilize AI Tools or would like to request a reasonable accommodation, within ten business days of your position application, you must email your request to MyHR@glic.com, making sure to provide your name and job requisition identification number. title: QE Manager
description:
About This Role
**6 years of experience**  

**Skills: Selenium, Playwright, Java / Python, REST API Testing, BDD / Cucumber, JUnit / Mockito, CI/CD, Postman / RestAssured, Performance Testing, Git, SQL, Agile, Shift\-Left Testing, Defect Management, JIRA**

**About the Role**
  

We are looking for an experienced Quality Engineer with 6\+ years of experience to design, build, and execute automated test solutions across enterprise applications. You will bring strong test automation skills combined with solid domain knowledge — embedding quality as a first\-class concern across Agile delivery teams. This is a hands\-on technical QE role requiring strong coding ability, deep automation framework expertise, and a shift\-left quality mindset.


**Key Responsibilities**


* Design, build, and maintain scalable test automation frameworks covering UI, API, integration, and E2E testing layers.
* Develop automation scripts using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright supporting functional, regression, and cross\-browser testing.
* Build and maintain REST API test automation suites using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman covering API contracts and business logic validation.
* Write unit and integration tests using JUnit and Mockito collaborating with developers to improve code testability and test coverage.
* Build and maintain BDD test frameworks using Cucumber and Gherkin working with product owners and BAs to define business\-readable acceptance criteria.
* Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines implementing quality gates that prevent defective code from reaching production.
* Champion shift\-left testing practices engaging with developers and architects early in the delivery lifecycle.
* Design and execute performance and load tests using JMeter or Gatling validating application scalability under realistic load conditions.
* Manage defect triage and reporting logging, prioritising, and tracking defects in Jira with clear business impact assessment.
* Mentor and coach junior QE team members sharing automation expertise across the team.

**What We're Looking For**


* 6\+ years of quality engineering experience with strong hands\-on technical automation expertise.
* Strong automation skills using Selenium WebDriver or Playwright building scalable, maintainable frameworks from scratch.
* Solid Java or Python skills writing production\-quality test automation code.
* Proven REST API testing expertise using RestAssured, Karate, or Postman.
* Experience with BDD frameworks including Cucumber and Gherkin for business\-readable test scenario automation.
* Strong CI/CD integration experience embedding quality gates into Jenkins, GitLab CI, or GitHub Actions pipelines.
* Good SQL skills for data validation and reconciliation testing.
* Strong shift\-left testing mindset engaging early in the delivery lifecycle to define testability and quality requirements.
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills working effectively across developers, product owners, and DevOps teams.

**Nice to Have**


* Performance and load testing experience using JMeter, Gatling, or k6\.
* Contract testing experience using Pact or Spring Cloud Contract.
* Accessibility testing knowledge including WCAG standards and Axe tools.
* AI assisted testing tools including Mabl, Testim, or Applitools.
* ISTQB Foundation or Advanced certification.
* Experience in Financial Services, Banking, or regulated industry environments.

title: Sr. Value Engineer
description:
OPENTEXT \- THE INFORMATION COMPANY
  
OpenText is a global leader in information management, where innovation, creativity, and collaboration are the key components of our corporate culture. As a member of our team, you will have the opportunity to partner with the most highly regarded companies in the world, tackle complex issues, and contribute to projects that shape the future of digital transformation.
  
  

AI\-First. Future\-Driven. Human\-Centered.
  
At OpenText, AI is at the heart of everything we do—powering innovation, transforming work, and empowering digital knowledge workers. We're hiring talent that AI can't replace to help us shape the future of information management. Join us.
  
  

**YOUR IMPACT:**  

The OpenText Value Engineer is responsible for helping customers realize and validate the business value of their investments in OpenText technologies.
  
This role combines strategic consulting, business transformation advisory, financial modeling, executive engagement, and value realization methodologies to translate technology investments into measurable business outcomes.
  
As a trusted advisor, the Value Engineer partners with Account Executives, Solution Consultants, Enterprise Architects, Customer Success teams, and Business Units to identify customer challenges, quantify business value, build executive business cases, and accelerate strategic transformation. The role also develops scalable, outcome\-focused demonstration use cases that showcase measurable value and enable consistent customer engagement globally.
  
  

**WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS :**  

* Conduct executive discovery workshops and customer value assessments.
* Research customer strategies, industry trends, market challenges, and transformation initiatives.
* Identify and quantify business challenges, risks, opportunities, and value drivers.
* Assess AI readiness, cloud modernization opportunities, and digital transformation maturity.
* Translate customer objectives into measurable improvement initiatives and transformation roadmaps.
* Develop executive\-level business cases supporting OpenText investments.
* Create ROI, TCO, cost avoidance, productivity, compliance, and value realization models.
* Support budgetary and investment approval processes through business value articulation
* Create value\-based storytelling assets that align customer challenges to measurable business outcomes.


**WHAT YOU NEED TO SUCCEED:**  

* Consultative selling and opportunity qualification
* Executive relationship management and strategic account planning
* Value storytelling and executive presentations
* Digital transformation, AI readiness and adoption
* Cloud modernization and information management
* Enterprise architecture and change management
* Demonstration design and storyboarding
* Cross\-product solution mapping


OpenText's efforts to build an inclusive work environment go beyond simply complying with applicable laws. Our Employment Equity and Diversity Policy provides direction on maintaining a working environment that is inclusive of everyone, regardless of culture, national origin, race, color, gender, gender identification, sexual orientation, family status, age, veteran status, disability, religion, or other basis protected by applicable laws.
  
If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or recruiting process, please contact us athr@opentext.com. Our proactive approach fosters collaboration, innovation, and personal growth, enriching OpenText's vibrant workplace.

title: Senior Distributed Application Support
description:
**About Our Company**


Ameriprise India LLP has been providing client based financial solutions to help clients plan and achieve their financial objectives for 20 years. We are part of Ameriprise Financial Inc., a US financial planning company headquartered in Minneapolis with a global presence and diversified financial services leader with more than $1\.5 trillion in assets under management, administration and advisement as of year\-end 2024\. The firm’s focus areas include Asset Management and Advice, Retirement Planning and Insurance Protection.


Be part of an inclusive, collaborative culture that rewards you for your contributions, and work with other talented individuals who share your passion for doing great work. You’ll also have plenty of opportunities to make your mark at the office and a difference in your community. So, if you're talented, driven and want to work for a strong, ethical company that cares, take the next step and create a career at Ameriprise India LLP.

**Job Description**


In this role the person will be the responsible for ensuring success of business critical application operations by supporting the day to day batch processing, analyzing and fixing the issues on priority while adhering to standards and SLA's. The person should be able to support High priority(P1/P2\) incidents dynamically by providing timely resolution for the problem and handle other service requests. The person will also be responsible for handling minor enhancements, perform code reviews, handle application outages(planned/unplanned) and responsible for performance and maintenance of the highly critical business application. For this role we are looking for a highly motivated Individual who will be working as Sr. operations analysts working in technologies. The person should exhibit leadership qualities and demonstrate business acumen while working closely with business users to understand requirements and help team translate it into technical changes.  

Provide end to end production support and derive immediate resolutions/root\-cause of the incidents arising in and around the Legal, Compliance and Supervision Application’s Distributed systems to ensure quick restoration of service degradation and hence minimal business impact.**Key Responsibilities**

* Work as part of Operations team primarily supporting the Distributed applications
* Respond to incidents as well as work to identify proactive incident circumvention
* Support the Batch Operations that occurs nightly for Distributed systems
* Work on rotation basis during the day and night Operations shift to support both night batches and the day time Operations work alternatively
* Identify and recommend performance enhancements/improvements for applications
* Provide 24x7 on\-call support and work during hours that accommodate a portion of the US work day or during the full US work day shift (India night shift) including weekends / holidays


Incident \& Problem Management

* Work towards quick resolution/recovery of the high priority incidents in a time\-bound manner to ensure business continuity and minimum downtimes
* Coordinate and drive restoration of service disruptions/business escalated issues to meet and exceed established SLAs/OLAs
* Ensure action plans are in place to address recurring issues, including escalation and effective hand\-off to other teams as required
* Work towards aggressive root cause analysis/permanent resolution for all the business impacting recurring technical issues


Change Management

* Participate in change reviews and understand operational impacts due to changes
* Continuous Service Improvement Initiatives
* Improve effectiveness and efficiency of existing processes
* Follow best practices to enhance service delivery
* Develop the ability to think and act strategically
* Engage in the business and technology interactions to improve the service quality
* Ensure appropriate quality checks to decrease the risks and errors
* Ensure to execute processes to optimize cost and quality

  

  

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, MIS, Information Technology, or equivalent experience.
* 4\-8 years of experience in Production Support, Application Operations, Cloud Operations, or Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) roles.
* Strong experience supporting distributed applications in Production environments.
* Hands\-on experience troubleshooting applications hosted in AWS Cloud environments including EC2, S3, Lambda, SNS, SQS, RDS and CloudWatch.
* Strong experience with: SQL and database troubleshooting Windows Server and Linux administration Java and/or .NET application support Enterprise batch scheduling platforms such as TWS (IBM Workload Scheduler), Tidal, Control\-M or equivalent
* Practical scripting experience with Bash Shell and PowerShell for production support, troubleshooting, operational automation, monitoring and batch processing.
* Experience automating manual operational tasks using PowerShell, Bash, Python or AWS native automation services.
* Experience supporting ETL workflows, data pipelines, file transfers and batch processing environments.
* Experience using monitoring and observability tools such as Dynatrace, Sumo Logic, CloudWatch or equivalent.
* Strong understanding of ITIL practices including Incident, Problem and Change Management.
* Proven experience in root cause analysis, service restoration and proactive incident prevention.

 **Preferred Qualifications**  

Candidates who have used following tools (or have familiarity with below) will have added advantage:•

* AWS Certified SysOps Administrator Associate (Highly Preferred)
* AWS Certified Solutions Architect Associate (Optional)
* ITIL Foundation Certification
* Experience supporting financial services, compliance, supervision, legal, or highly regulated applications.
* Experience with: AWS Cloud Operations DevOps and CI/CD concepts Infrastructure as Code (Terraform/CloudFormation) Python automation development
* Knowledge of ETL platforms such as Informatica, AWS Glue, IDMC, or equivalent.
* Experience building operational dashboards, monitoring solutions, and automated alerting mechanisms.
* Knowledge of Mainframe environments and scheduling integrations is a plus.
* Proven track record of identifying automation opportunities and reducing operational overhead through scripting and process improvements.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to communicate effectively with both technical and business stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with a proactive operational mindset

**In\-Office Collaboration**

* We are a client\-centric, relationship\-based business. Working together, in\-person, is foundational to how we achieve results. By fostering a culture of face\-to\-face collaboration, idea sharing, productivity and personal connection, we deliver for our stakeholders — clients, advisors, employees and shareholders. Our employees work in the office at least three (3\) days per week, with flexibility to work from home two (2\) days per week. Some roles may require additional in\-office time or different in\-office expectations, and specific requirements will be discussed during the hiring process.
